question.text: A PM offering discretionary services MUST obtain from each client:

explanation.text: The Logic: Complete onboarding: KYC, Disclosure Document, MITC (Oct 2024 onwards), signed PMS Agreement, PAN, bank, demat details. The Trap: Partial onboarding is insufficient. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A foundation; XXI-B tests. Manager's Pro-Tip: Create a standard onboarding checklist and run it through compliance sign-off before first trade.
